CREATE SEQUENCE ${tableName}_id_seq INCREMENT 1 START 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 2147483647 CACHE 1; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${tableName} ( ID INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval( '${tableName}_id_seq' :: regclass ), geom geometry, calarea DOUBLE PRECISION, tbmj DOUBLE PRECISION, calarea1 DOUBLE PRECISION, bsm1 CHARACTER VARYING ( 50 ) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", dlbm1 CHARACTER VARYING ( 20 ) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", dlmc1 CHARACTER VARYING ( 20 ) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", tbmj1 DOUBLE PRECISION, calarea2 DOUBLE PRECISION, bsm2 CHARACTER VARYING ( 50 ) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", dlbm2 CHARACTER VARYING ( 20 ) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", dlmc2 CHARACTER VARYING ( 20 ) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", tbmj2 DOUBLE PRECISION, create_time timestamp with time zone, CONSTRAINT ${tableName}_pkey PRIMARY KEY ( ID ) ); ALTER SEQUENCE ${tableName}_id_seq OWNED BY ${tableName}.ID; CREATE INDEX ${tableName}_geom_idx ON ${tableName} USING gist ( geom );

INSERT INTO ${targetTableName} (geom, calarea, tbmj, calarea1, bsm1, dlbm1, dlmc1, tbmj1, calarea2, bsm2, dlbm2, dlmc2, tbmj2, create_time) SELECT geom, calarea, calarea/calarea2*tbmj2 tbmj, calarea1, bsm1, dlbm1, dlmc1, tbmj1, calarea2, bsm2, dlbm2, dlmc2, tbmj2, now() FROM ( SELECT calarea1, bsm1, dlbm1, dlmc1, tbmj1, calarea2, bsm2, dlbm2, dlmc2, tbmj2, geom, st_area(st_transform(tt1.geom, CAST ( ( FLOOR ( ( ST_X ( st_centroid ( tt1.geom ) ) + 1.5 ) / 3 ) + 4488 ) AS INTEGER ))) calarea FROM ( SELECT t1.calarea calarea1, t1.bsm bsm1, t1.dlbm dlbm1, t1.dlmc dlmc1, t1.tbmj tbmj1, t1.geom geom1, t2.calarea calarea2, t2.bsm bsm2, t2.dlbm dlbm2, t2.dlmc dlmc2, t2.tbmj tbmj2, t2.geom geom2, st_intersection ( t1.geom, t2.geom) geom FROM ${tableName1} t1, ${tableName2} t2 WHERE st_intersects ( t1.geom, t2.geom ) ORDER BY t1.bsm, t2.bsm ) tt1 ) ttt1 WHERE ttt1.calarea > ${areaTolerance}
